name: Foodie Media Berhad
overview: 2026 年 Foodie Media 与 Malaysia Tourism Promotion Board 签订谅解备忘录，围绕 Visit Malaysia 2026 推广马来西亚文化遗产景点与传统美食；与 Taobao (Singapore) 及 W Talent Academy 的谅解备忘录年内多次更新，均无重大进展。公司全年营收由 3708.6 万 MYR 增至 5548.9 万 MYR，净利润由 934.4 万 MYR 增至 1567.2 万 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, Foodie Media entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Malaysia Tourism Promotion Board to promote Malaysian heritage attractions and traditional cuisine under the Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign; its MOU with Taobao (Singapore) and W Talent Academy was updated several times during the year with no material development. Full-year revenue rose from MYR 37.086 million to MYR 55.489 million, and net profit from MYR 9.344 million to MYR 15.672 million.

segments.note: 年内与 Tourism Malaysia 签署谅解备忘录，并与 Taobao (Singapore) 及 W Talent Academy 的谅解备忘录持续更新但无重大进展。
segments.note_en: Signed an MOU with Tourism Malaysia during the year, while the MOU with Taobao (Singapore) and W Talent Academy was updated with no material development.
